evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: New article: care directed at an ill person, noun and transitive suru.
rows.sourceNote: Illness-specific care does not itself identify a professional nursing qualification.

rows.mappingNote: New kanmuri article for crown/diadem; explicitly distinguish supplementary kan best/foremost construction from the primary reading.
rows.sourceNote: The raw gloss bundles crown/diadem with first/best, but sense 5 is restricted to kan. Traditional headgear, top radical and naming/sponsorship uses are additional teaching, not separate N2 assignments.
rows.identityNote: Primary kanmuri retained. Supplementary kan-taru is visibly read kan, not kanmuri; kamuri haikai sense and kan title counter are not selected.

rows.mappingNote: New article teaches abbreviation of kanwa-jiten and the full dictionary expression; country/language uses are additional.
rows.sourceNote: A dictionary explaining kanji and kanji compounds in Japanese, not simply modern Chinese-to-Japanese translation. Separate kanna is not imported.

rows.mappingNote: New article for atmospheric/air pressure; atmosphere pressure-unit use is additional teaching.
rows.sourceNote: Distinguish a measured pressure from air itself or a social atmosphere; no numeric unit conversion or weather prediction is asserted.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse existing N3 machine/mechanism identity, with explicit instrument/apparatus spelling 器械 and a new original experiment-apparatus sentence.
rows.sourceNote: Preserve primary 機械, reading, title, N3 level and original exclusion list. 器械 is a spelling tendency, not an absolute disjoint meaning.
rows.identityNote: Both source and principal spelling belong to 1220810 at reading きかい. Existing machine sense remains teaching, without assigning it a new N2 level.

rows.mappingNote: New article teaches changing clothes and a replacement set of clothing, with construction-specific examples.
rows.sourceNote: Main spelling 着替え. 着換え is marked rare; search-only forms are retained in evidence rather than promoted as new writing recommendations.

rows.mappingNote: New article for locomotive/train engine, not every engine or complete train.
rows.sourceNote: 汽車 includes a steam locomotive; 機関車 itself is not restricted to steam power.

rows.mappingNote: New article for famine/crop failure; additional chronic-shortage teaching demonstrated with 水飢饉.
rows.sourceNote: Retain all written characters despite missing cards. 饑饉 is a rare kanji spelling; 水飢饉 has complete separate supporting evidence.

rows.mappingNote: New article for utensils, implements and apparatus, illustrated through cooking and experiment contexts.
rows.sourceNote: Not kitchen-only or necessarily powered equipment. Apparatus/tool comparisons are tendencies, not exclusive categories.

rows.mappingNote: New article for a set term/time frame, with additional deadline/time-limit use explicitly taught.
rows.sourceNote: Preserve raw term/period gloss while explaining limit emphasis, rather than discarding sense 1 in favor of deadline only.

rows.mappingNote: New article for sign/symbol/mark, with the raw code gloss explicitly qualified.
rows.sourceNote: Code is contextual sign/notation wording, not all computer-program, cord or chord senses of コード.

rows.mappingNote: New article for fine cutting and engraving, with rhythm/time and mental-etching uses as additional teaching.
rows.sourceNote: Godan mu conjugation is explicit. Archaic tattoo/torment and specialist golf uses remain in evidence but are not lesson requirements.

rows.mappingNote: New article for ceremony/rite/ritual, including religious-service English wording.
rows.sourceNote: The English service label does not make every commercial サービス a Japanese synonym; 勤め has an actual religious-service sense.

rows.mappingNote: New shared article for 基準 and 規準 at the same reading and family sense.
rows.sourceNote: Separate actual Daijisen definitions establish reference/requirements versus normative conduct emphases, not universally interchangeable spellings or a rigid technical-domain partition.

rows.mappingNote: Map source 規準 to the explicitly taught alias in 基準, with pronunciation, conduct-standard example and 規 backlink.
rows.sourceNote: Both spellings and the shared reading are visible. Two source rows do not require duplicate word identities.
rows.identityNote: Same 1591210 family and きじゅん reading; source spelling remains separately recorded, not rewritten as 基準.

rows.mappingNote: New article for rising from bed, noun and intransitive suru.
rows.sourceNote: Getting out of bed is distinguished from merely waking; 床 contributes bed/bedding here, not a mechanically assigned floor sense.

rows.mappingNote: New clothing-on-another article at きせる, distinct from existing かぶせる 被せる.
rows.sourceNote: Show recipient ni and garment o, lexical ichidan conjugation, and supplementary coating/imposed-blame expressions.
rows.identityNote: 1422990 has primary きせる and recognizes 被せる spelling. Existing 1484320 card retains primary かぶせる and all baseline metadata.

rows.mappingNote: New article for physical and figurative foundation/basis.
rows.sourceNote: Building and learning examples distinguish context without making easy knowledge a required meaning.

rows.mappingNote: New article for gas/gaseous substance and contextual vapour wording.
rows.sourceNote: ガス includes the gaseous-state sense, not fuel only; liquid and solid are contrasts rather than exclusions merely by category.

rows.mappingNote: New article for military/expedition/operational base as a place.
rows.sourceNote: Not military-only; distinct from generic supporting stands or abstract foundations. Jocular Internet enthusiast suffix in sense 2 is retained as evidence, not silently selected.

quizGuardRationale: Declarations are direct, symmetric and nontransitive. Exact duplicate titles already deduplicate. Baseline declarations are unchanged. Neither a shared subject area nor a source-family cross-reference automatically requires a guard.
看病 protects actual care/nursing labels on 世話, 医療, 面倒 and 厄介, not a claim that family caregiving is always clinical treatment or a profession.
冠 protects cap/headgear, ordinary naming/title sense 6, and the explicitly reading-qualified formal best/foremost sense 5 against actual labels. It does not pronounce that sense かんむり.
漢和 protects broader dictionary labels. English-Japanese 英和 remains a meaningful language/dictionary contrast, not an exclusion merely by category.
気圧 protects pressure and unqualified atmosphere labels, including English unit/air/mood polysemy. These are not unrestricted Japanese substitutions.
着替え protects the clothing sense against 服 and 衣服, not every garment subtype or every action involving clothes.
機関車 protects generic engine labels and 汽車's actual steam-locomotive sense. Generic 列車/電車 are not automatically excluded merely because they concern railways.
飢饉 protects the actual chronic-shortage use against 不足.
器具 protects actual tool, implement, apparatus and equipment labels. Musical-instrument specialization alone does not make every 楽器 a direct synonym.

期限 protects actual term/period/time-frame labels, including broad period wording; the lesson still distinguishes deadline/allowed-term emphasis from duration or an era. Week, year and semester labels are not automatically guards.
記号 protects mark/sign labels and the source's qualified code wording. A particular equals sign does not make generic 記号 synonymous with イコール in every context.
刻む protects cutting and ordinary mental-etching/remembering meanings; archaic and golf senses remain in evidence without requiring a whole-topic guard.
儀式 protects ceremony, 勤め's actual religious-service sense and English service polysemy against サービス. Commercial assistance is not thereby a Japanese ritual.
基準 protects standard, basis, measure/gauge, norm/rule and actual requirements labels; a noun/verb difference alone does not disambiguate an untyped English label.
起床 protects 起きる's actual getting-up sense. Merely waking, sunrise and rising prices are not treated as the same meaning.

着せる protects clothing/put-on labels and ordinary secondary covering/coating/imposed-blame uses. Separate かぶせる and きせる identities remain explicit; guards do not license unrestricted collocation or particle substitution.
基礎 protects basis/foundation/basic and physical supporting-base labels. 基地 only protects 素's unqualified English base label, not every word related to foundations or stands.
気体/ガス is a direct gas-state overlap. 空気/大気 identify air rather than all gases; liquid and solid are distinct contrasts, not topic-only guards.
sourceAccessLimits: Eighteen new articles, one scoped reuse of existing N3 機械 for source 器械, and one shared 基準/規準 mapping cover twenty rows. Reuse is not whole-article recertification.
Four new primary-form N2 pairs: 圧/気圧, 替/着替え, 準/基準 and 床/起床. Reused 械/機械 remains reciprocal and gains explicit 器械 navigation. Alias backlinks on 規 and 被 target forms actually taught.
Missing component cards 儀, 冠, 器, 基, 看, 礎, 飢, 饉 and 饑 are not manufactured. All written primary-form characters remain in metadata. Rare alias components are retained in complete source evidence.
All baseline IDs, primary readings, titles, written-kanji lists, easier sourced levels and original exclusions remain unchanged. Related edits are narrow examples/navigation and source attribution.
Complete source families retain unselected readings, flags and specialist/historical meanings. Selected/additional senses are not independent official N2 assignments.
Inspection receipts record actual author access, not independent reviewer verification. Simplified pages lacking lexical bodies are not counted as definition checks.

Original examples are teaching sentences, not corpus quotations. No measured frequency, native-speaker certification, executed app draw, quantitative pressure conversion or new official syllabus is claimed.
Constituent associations are teaching aids, not historical etymology. Kanji reading metadata does not override a vocabulary item's actual whole reading.
